NDC9.name: Drug Product Code (NDC, 9-digit)
NDC9.desc: the FDA's code for one drug product from one maker — the first 9 digits of the 11-digit NDC on a price file; the two only line up after padding to 5-4

UDI_DI.name: Medical Device ID (UDI-DI)
UDI_DI.desc: the FDA's ID for one model of medical device, as printed on its label

FDA_APP_NO.name: FDA Drug Approval # (NDA / ANDA / BLA)
FDA_APP_NO.desc: the application number under which the FDA approved a drug — brand (NDA), generic (ANDA), or biologic (BLA); 13,093 in-house, no approvals file held to receive them

DMF_NO.name: FDA Drug Master File #
DMF_NO.desc: the FDA's file number for a confidential manufacturing dossier a supplier keeps on file

HIOS_ID.name: Health Plan ID (HIOS)
HIOS_ID.desc: the marketplace ID for a health insurer, plus longer versions for one of its products or plans — the first health-plan key in-house, no partner table yet

BHCMIS.name: HRSA Health Center ID
BHCMIS.desc: the grant-program ID for a federally funded community health center (the parent of its clinic sites)

PECOS_PAC.name: PECOS Owner / Associate ID
PECOS_PAC.desc: Medicare's ID for an owner or affiliated organization in its provider-enrollment system

CHAIN_ID.name: Nursing-Home Chain ID
CHAIN_ID.desc: Medicare's ID for the ownership group a nursing home belongs to — there is no master list, names only

NPDB_PRACT.name: Practitioner # (NPDB)
NPDB_PRACT.desc: the anonymous per-practitioner key inside the malpractice / discipline reporting bank — links reports to each other, not to a named person

NRC_SEQ.name: Spill / Incident Report # (NRC)
NRC_SEQ.desc: the National Response Center's number for one reported spill, leak, or incident

NFIP_COMMUNITY.name: Flood Program Community ID
NFIP_COMMUNITY.desc: FEMA's ID for a town or county that takes part in the flood insurance program; joins disasters by place, not by id

AQS_SITE.name: Air Monitor Site ID (AQS)
AQS_SITE.desc: the EPA's state + county + site code for one air-quality monitor; joins by place

WQP_SITE.name: Water Monitoring Station ID
WQP_SITE.desc: the ID for one water-quality sampling station (shares its numbering with USGS gauges)

FDIC_CERT.name: FDIC Bank Certificate #
FDIC_CERT.desc: the FDIC's ID for an insured bank; also used for successor, direct-parent, and ultimate-parent bank pointers

RSSD.name: Federal Reserve Bank ID (RSSD)
RSSD.desc: the Fed's ID for a bank

RSSD_HC.name: Bank Holding-Company ID (RSSD)
RSSD_HC.desc: the Fed's ID for the holding company that owns a bank — the holding-company master file is NOT held, so this only links tables that both point at it

FHFA_ID.name: Home Loan Bank Member ID (FHFA)
FHFA_ID.desc: the FHFA's ID for a member of the Federal Home Loan Bank system

NAIC_ID.name: Insurance Company ID (NAIC)
NAIC_ID.desc: the state insurance regulators' shared ID for an insurer — the first insurance key in the warehouse (618 insurers on the home-loan-bank membership file); no insurer master held

FHA_MORTGAGEE.name: FHA Lender #
FHA_MORTGAGEE.desc: HUD's ID for a lender approved to make FHA-insured mortgages

HMDA_ARID.name: Old HMDA Lender ID (pre-2018 respondent id)
HMDA_ARID.desc: the pre-2018 mortgage-lending lender ID — two number systems in one column, told apart by the agency code: bank-regulator rows are a bank certificate #, HUD rows are a tax ID. Currently unreliable as a bank join; use the official crosswalk to LEI instead

SEC_SERIES_ID.name: SEC Fund Series ID
SEC_SERIES_ID.desc: the SEC's ID for a registered investment fund (its share classes get class IDs)

SEC_FILE_NO.name: SEC File #
SEC_FILE_NO.desc: the SEC's filing-series number for a registrant (1940-Act, 13F, and insider filings each have their own)

CRD.name: Broker / Adviser # (CRD)
CRD.desc: FINRA's ID for a brokerage or investment-adviser firm — held on 13F filers only; the discipline records (IAPD / BrokerCheck) are not held

PCAOB_ID.name: Audit Firm / Engagement IDs (PCAOB)
PCAOB_ID.desc: the audit regulator's IDs for an audit firm, the company it audited, and the engagement partner

MIC.name: Market Identifier Code (MIC)
MIC.desc: the ISO code for a stock exchange or trading venue

GLEIF_RA_ID.name: National Company # (via LEI record)
GLEIF_RA_ID.desc: the home-country registry number each LEI record carries — a UK company number, a Delaware file number, etc.; only the UK registry is held to receive them

FARA_NO.name: Foreign Agent Registration #
FARA_NO.desc: the Justice Department's ID for a registered foreign agent or lobbyist

IRS_GEN.name: IRS Group Exemption #
IRS_GEN.desc: the IRS number for a nonprofit umbrella (a church body, a chapter system) covering many local groups

MC_DOCKET.name: Trucking Operating Authority # (MC / FF / MX)
MC_DOCKET.desc: the federal permit number for a carrier, freight forwarder, or Mexican carrier — 40% of carriers carry one

USDOT.name: Trucking Company # (USDOT)
USDOT.desc: the federal safety ID for a trucking or bus company

USCG_PARTY.name: Vessel Owner ID (Coast Guard)
USCG_PARTY.desc: the Coast Guard's ID for a person or company on a vessel document

HIN.name: Hull ID Number (HIN)
HIN.desc: the serial number stamped on a boat's hull

IMO.name: Ship Hull Number (IMO)
IMO.desc: the permanent international ID for a ship — survives renames and reflagging

MMSI.name: Ship Radio ID (MMSI)
MMSI.desc: the 9-digit radio ID a ship broadcasts; 22,759 in the ship-tracking data with no owner registry held

CALLSIGN.name: Ship Radio Call Sign
CALLSIGN.desc: the radio call sign assigned to a vessel

OFAC_ENT_NUM.name: Sanctions Entry # (OFAC)
OFAC_ENT_NUM.desc: Treasury's number for one entry on the sanctions list; the consolidated screening list reuses it

OPENSANCTIONS_ID.name: OpenSanctions ID
OPENSANCTIONS_ID.desc: the cross-regime ID for a sanctioned person, company, or vessel; its bag of other identifiers (Wikidata, IMO, tax ids) still needs parsing

OSHA_EST_ID.name: OSHA Establishment ID
OSHA_EST_ID.desc: OSHA's ID for one workplace in the injury-summary filings — about half persist year to year

ORI.name: Police Agency ID (ORI)
ORI.desc: the FBI's ID for a law-enforcement agency; 4,878 present on the police-violence data, no agency master held

N_NUMBER.name: Aircraft Tail Number (N-number)
N_NUMBER.desc: the FAA registration mark painted on a U.S. aircraft — reissued after an aircraft leaves the registry

RR_CODE.name: Railroad Reporting Code
RR_CODE.desc: the FRA's short code for a railroad company

FAIN.name: Federal Grant Award ID (FAIN)
FAIN.desc: the ID for one federal grant or assistance award

PIID.name: Federal Contract ID (PIID)
PIID.desc: the ID for one federal contract; the 'parent award' version is an umbrella-contract (IDV) ID whose file is NOT held

CAGE.name: Defense Contractor Code (CAGE)
CAGE.desc: the DoD's 5-character code for a supplier location

NIH_PROJECT.name: NIH Project #
NIH_PROJECT.desc: the core number for one NIH-funded research project

EIA_UTILITY_ID.name: Power Utility ID (EIA)
EIA_UTILITY_ID.desc: the Energy Department's ID for an electric utility; plant owners and grid owners point at it

FERC_DOCKET.name: FERC Docket #
FERC_DOCKET.desc: the energy regulator's case number for a qualifying facility or wholesale generator — first FERC ids in-house, no FERC table held

HUD_CONTRACT.name: HUD Section 8 Contract / Property ID
HUD_CONTRACT.desc: HUD's IDs for a subsidized-housing contract and the property it covers

USDA_RD_BORROWER.name: USDA Rural Housing Borrower ID
USDA_RD_BORROWER.desc: the USDA's ID for a rural multifamily borrower

corrections.was: Pass 1 called the TRI facility file's FRS column dead.
corrections.now: That column IS dead, but the same table's EPA registry-id column is live: 64,728 distinct, 99.9% resolve into the EPA facility registry. TRI <-> FRS is a solid edge (listed below).

corrections.was: Pass 1 reported ISIN empty after checking a 200-row XBRL flag table.
corrections.now: Confirmed on the right table: 48,990 rows, 100% blank. ISIN is not held.

corrections.was: Pass 1 left the nursing-home 'affiliation entity id' unverified as a possible PECOS id.
corrections.now: It is the nursing-home chain id (635 distinct, identical to CHAIN_ID); 0% match to PECOS.

corrections.was: The 08-05 catalog listed 37 ID systems as 'not held'.
corrections.now: They are held (device IDs, malpractice bank, adverse events, Coast Guard vessels, UK ownership, retractions, single audits, EIA plant/utility ids, ...).

traps: Drug codes: the price file prints an 11-digit NDC, the FDA directory prints a dashed 9-digit one. Zero-pad both to 5-4 before joining; a raw string join gives 0%.

Old HMDA lender id (pre-2018) is two number systems in one column. Bank-regulator rows (agency codes 1-3) are a bank certificate #; HUD rows (agency 7) are a tax ID. Split by agency code or the join is half wrong.
Trucking-company DUNS shows 3.85M 'junk' values because 86% of carriers report 0. The 372K real values are fine — filter the zeros, don't discard the column.
Debarred parties' UEIs mostly do NOT resolve into the contractor registry (0.3%). Expected: excluded parties are people and defunct firms, not a load failure.

Contracts 'parent award id' is an umbrella-contract (IDV) id. Joining it to the contract-id column is the wrong test (0.2%); the IDV file is a separate download that is not held — 387K parent ids point nowhere.
The SBIR awards 'state' column is not a state code (0% agreement with the contractor registry on confirmed name matches). Do not use it as geography.
